description: This file defines an internal class 'Orleans3CompatibleStringKeyHasher' that implements the 'IHasher' interface for hashing string-only grain key IDs in Orleans v3. It provides methods for hashing byte arrays with special handling to distinguish between grain type names and other data, utilizing an inner hasher and encoding logic.

classes.name: Orleans3CompatibleStringKeyHasher
classes.description: Implements hashing logic for string-based grain key IDs compatible with Orleans v3, utilizing an inner hasher and extension to handle string distinctions.

methods.name: Orleans3CompatibleStringKeyHasher
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the hasher with an inner hasher and the grain type string.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Property providing a description of the hasher, indicating Orleans v3 hash function usage.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Generates an integer hash for the provided byte array, with special handling if data represents a grain type name.

methods.name: IsGrainTypeName
methods.description: Determines if the input byte array matches the grain type's UTF-8 encoded bytes.
